attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Vex's Crew has two settlements operating nearby.","severity":"minor","reason":"The briefing gives the settlement count but not their location relative to Hearthstead."},{"span":"They are always operating nearby, which is usually the problem.","severity":"minor","reason":"Implies a pattern of activity the briefing does not mention."},{"span":"They are perpetually short on supplies, as usual.","severity":"minor","reason":"Inflates one lost wagon into a chronic shortage, stated as fact."}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"Calling the only new item 'hardly news' undercuts the lead, and the remaining items lean on embellishments (Vex's Crew 'nearby', the Covenant 'perpetually short'). The wit is thin and generic next to the sharper earlier bulletins."}
